page.overview:
Who is Major Bludd?

Sebastian Bludd also known as Major Bludd is a mercenary working for the terrorist organisation Cobra. He makes a cameo in the opening sequence of G.I. Joe: Retaliation.

Major Bludd makes a cameo in the opening sequence of the film. He is on a data sheet showing various Cobra agents and lists him as one of them. According to the data sheet his current Location is Sydney, Australia.
